title: Two Steps, No Exit
setup: White's bishop stands on h4, and White has already played g3, closing one of its two retreat squares.
hint: White's own pawn already blocks one of the bishop's two exits. Who controls the other one?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{g5}} attacks the bishop, and h4 has exactly two diagonal squares. g3 holds White's own pawn, and the pawn now on g5 is defended by h6, so Bxg5 hxg5 hands over a piece for a pawn. Trapping is about squares, not about attacks.
